meta.name: The Slums
meta.blurb: Where the sickness strikes first and the desperate gather.

activities.name: Give alms to the poor
activities.blurb: Bread, coin, and clean water for the wall-side families the rest of the town has written off.

activities.name: Fight crime
activities.blurb: Stand with the bailiff's failing watch against a quarter that is coming apart.

activities.name: Gamble in the streets
activities.blurb: Dice in doorways with the desperate, where the coin runs short and the whispers run long.
